subject: Recap: Stakeholder map + ask for finance/procurement contacts
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novumai.com>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Stakeholder map + ask for finance/procurement contacts

Hi Asha — thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it's fresh: 

- Goal: Validate use case (inference latency/cost for 10k monthly active users) and agree on pilot success criteria.
- Decision timeline you mentioned: procurement review in late Nov, leadership sign-off in Dec.
- Immediate asks from our side: intro to the economic/budget owner and the procurement/security contact so we can surface the minimal paperwork and timeline.

Could you introduce me to the person who owns the budget for infra/AI (title you referenced: VP Finance or Head of AI Ops)? If there's a preferred procurement contact (vendor onboarding or SSO/contract lead) and a security reviewer (for SOC2/audit evidence), please loop them in — even a one-line intro is ideal.

I've attached a one-page stakeholder map and a short mutual action plan template that we can adapt to NovumAI's timeline. Also listing the quick docs they commonly ask for: SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, and standard SLA draft. If it's helpful I can draft an email to your procurement team to speed things up.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro to budget owner + procurement/security (this week)
2) We send pilot SOW + cost estimate (within 3 business days of intros)
3) 2-week pilot kickoff (target mid-Nov)

Thanks — copying Aditya (technical) and Marissa (customer success) so they have context.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RWD-MAP-1pager.pdf (1pg), Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novumai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Stakeholder map + ask for finance/procurement contacts

Thanks Grace — great summary and appreciated the docs.

Quick answers:
- Budget owner: Liam O'Connor (VP Finance) — he's focused on cloud spend and vendor commitments. I've copied him below.
- Procurement: Emily Tran (Vendor Mgmt) handles onboarding and legal redlines.
- Security: we have a central security operations team but for vendor questions please loop in Raj Mehta (secops lead).

I'll do a three-line intro to each and call out the pilot scope and timeline you suggested. Two notes from my side:
1) Liam typically wants a clear TCO view and a sandbox test that mirrors peak traffic for 48 hours.
2) Procurement will request SOC2 and a list of sub-processors.

Looping in Liam now so he sees the plan.

Onward —
Asha

--
Asha Patel
Head of Product, NovumAI
asha.patel@novumai.com

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novumai.com>

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novumai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@novumai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Intro — budget + next steps

Thanks for the intro, Asha. Grace — nice to meet you. Brief context from my side: NovumAI is planning a Q1 product launch and we've carved out an infra budget specifically for inference services. Before we proceed I need:

- A concise cost model for the pilot (expected spend for the 2-week sandbox and projected monthly run-rate at 10k MAU).
- Confirmation of data handling (what logs persist, where data is stored, retention controls).
- SOC2 summary and any recent penetration test reports.

If you can send the above by COB Monday I can put the initial approval in front of finance and procurement. Also FYI — procurement will run contract redlines but aims to avoid bespoke SLA changes for pilots.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
VP Finance, NovumAI
liam.oconnor@novumai.com

Hi Liam — really appreciate the clear list. We're aligned on timeline: shipping a pilot cost estimate + short TCO snapshot and SOC2 summary by Monday COB.

Action items (Grace / Redwood team):
- Aditya will produce a 48-hr load projection and pilot cost estimate (we'll include a best/worst case column).
- I'll attach the SOC2-summary and a short data-handling note (what we log, how long it persists, and opt-out controls).
- Marissa will draft a short pilot SOW and acceptance criteria so procurement has something concrete.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (1pg) — included; I also attached a draft mutual action plan (we can edit).

If procurement or security want a deeper technical review, Aditya is available for a 30-min call next week. Would you like us to schedule that now or wait until you've had a look at the docs?

Thanks — Grace
